en-GB.promotionalText: Encrypted while you film, sent every few seconds to your own server. Nothing readable stays on the phone.
en-GB.description:
Témoin records photos and video for moments when the phone itself is at risk: it can be seized, broken or forced open. Recordings are encrypted in memory while you film and uploaded every few seconds to a server that you or your group control. That server stores them but can never read them; only the organizer's key can.

• Join a server by scanning an invitation QR code. No account, no phone number, no email.
• Start filming from the lock screen. Video is cut into short segments, each encrypted and sent as soon as it is ready.
• Nothing readable is kept on the phone. If it is taken, what was already sent is safe.
• Get your own recordings back through a one-time download link.

The server runs on a home computer (free Windows and Mac app), a NAS or a VPS. Témoin is free software (AGPL-3.0). It was built with AI assistance and has not been audited yet.

fr-FR.promotionalText: Chiffré pendant que vous filmez, envoyé toutes les quelques secondes vers votre propre serveur. Rien de lisible ne reste sur le téléphone.
fr-FR.description:
Témoin filme et photographie quand le téléphone lui-même est en danger : il peut être saisi, cassé ou forcé. Les enregistrements sont chiffrés en mémoire pendant que vous filmez et envoyés toutes les quelques secondes vers un serveur que vous ou votre groupe contrôlez. Ce serveur les garde mais ne peut jamais les lire ; seule la clé de l'organisateur le peut.

• Rejoignez un serveur en scannant un QR d'invitation. Ni compte, ni numéro, ni e-mail.
• Filmez depuis l'écran verrouillé. La vidéo est découpée en courts segments, chacun chiffré et envoyé dès qu'il est prêt.
• Rien de lisible n'est gardé sur le téléphone. S'il est pris, ce qui a déjà été envoyé est à l'abri.
• Récupérez vos propres enregistrements par un lien de téléchargement à usage unique.

Le serveur tourne sur un ordinateur à la maison (appli gratuite pour Windows et Mac), un NAS ou un VPS. Témoin est un logiciel libre (AGPL-3.0). Il a été développé avec l'aide d'une IA et n'a pas encore été audité.

reviewNotes:
1. Screen recording: attached to our reply in App Store Connect (iPhone, latest iOS): launch, joining a server by QR code, video, photo and live capture with the upload status, then the recordings received on the server.

2. Purpose and audience: Témoin is a camera for adults who need to document an event (an incident, an accident, damage, a dispute) and want the footage to survive even if the phone is lost, broken or taken. Photos and videos are encrypted on the phone while they are being recorded and uploaded every few seconds to a server run by the user's own group (a family, an association, a small team). The server stores the files but cannot read them; only the holder of the group's private key can decrypt them on a computer. Nothing readable stays on the phone.

3. Setup: no account and no login. There is no central server and no default server: each group runs its own. To test, install the free desktop server on a Mac (signed and notarized): https://github.com/temoin-app/temoin/releases/latest -> "Temoin.Server_..._universal.dmg". Open it, follow the 3-step setup (create a key and its passphrase, save a copy), click Start, then "Invite a phone". In the app, tap "Scan an invitation QR code", scan it, check the server key and tap Trust. Then film: Video (default), Photo or Live, tap the red button; the status at the top shows the parts being sent. The recordings appear in the desktop app under "Recordings" and are decrypted with "Recover". A Docker image is also available (docs/SELF-HOSTING.md in the repository).

4. External services: none operated by us. The app only talks to the server chosen by the user. The desktop server can optionally use a Cloudflare quick tunnel (cloudflared) to be reachable without router configuration, or Let's Encrypt for HTTPS. No analytics, ads, tracking, sign-in provider, payments or AI services. Location is optional and stored only inside the encrypted file.

5. Regions: the app works the same in all regions (English and French interface).

6. Not a regulated industry and no third-party protected content. No user accounts, no paid content, and no content shared with other users (recordings only go to the group's own server, there is no public feed). The app is open source (AGPL-3.0): https://github.com/temoin-app/temoin
